page.overview:
Who is Curse Devil?

The いの|Noroi no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of curses.

When summoned, the Curse Devil manifests as a large, two-headed skeleton with horns, its right skull appears human while the left skull has three eye slits and longer, mandible-like teeth. The Curse Devil has clawed hands and a large, distended ribcage.

Whenever it speaks to someone the Curse Devil appears as a dark pair of lips hovering in darkness or as a monstrously large mouth. In the anime, this was changed, with the Curse Devil physically appearing behind the one he speaks to.

The Curse Devil's personality is currently unknown.
